zh: 校园卡支持 CSV/ICS 文件交换：明确确认字段映射与时区、逐行修正或跳过、重复项更新或保留，以及带修订校验的原子导入。导出可选事项类型和完成状态，保留日期语义及受支持的日历扩展字段。
en: Campus cards support CSV/ICS exchange with confirmed field mapping and time zones, editable row previews, duplicate decisions and atomic revision-checked imports. Exports filter by item type and status while preserving date semantics and supported calendar extensions.
